items.item: `Insert.query` traps with `precondition` on an update `where` without `DO UPDATE` assign
items.reason: Fixed without a full type-level restriction: whether DO UPDATE has assignments is only known at run time (doUpdate is a closure that may assign nothing, including the default { _, _ in }), so no overload split can rule it out. The precondition is replaced by the package's existing failure channel: Insert.query appends an ISO_9075.Value.invalid(Failure) segment, so ISO_9075.Dialect.render/inline throw ISO_9075.Value.Failure("Insert statement has an update 'where' without 'DO UPDATE' assignments: ...") when the statement is executed, the same way UInt64 overflow surfaces. Splitting the ~14 insert overloads so a static update where requires a non-defaulted doUpdate is left to the owner if still wanted.

notes: Tests: new Tests/SQL Tests/Insert Tests.swift (uses Reminder and Numbered from SQL Tests.swift): an update where with no doUpdate throws ISO_9075.Value.Failure on render; with assignments the DO UPDATE ... WHERE renders. Observation, not touched: several existing tests in Tests/SQL Tests/SQL Tests.swift call Numbered().render(...)/Positional().render(...) without try although ISO_9075.Dialect.render is throws(ISO_9075.Value.Failure) in the current swift-iso-9075 checkout; check whether that target compiles.
